name: Primal Adversary — paid twice: two lands become 3/3 Wolf creature lands with haste
notes: Sweep group 2 (2026-10-07). "you may pay {1}{G} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then up to that many target lands you control become 3/3 Wolf creatures with haste that are still lands." parsed to nothing. The fired text reads "Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature. Up to X target lands …" and the fired ability takes an X value (times paid), saved with the board. The plural "that are still lands" no longer becomes an ability "Haste That Are Still Lands".
